title: Mind Management Arcade
unlocks: desk decorations, productivity themes and focus boosters

games.name: Thought Catcher
games.how: Catch the useful thoughts in your notebook. Dodge the spirals.
games.teaches: Write it down to get it out of your head. Not every thought needs acting on.

games.name: Brain Sort
games.how: Today, later or never? Sort each thought fast.
games.teaches: Most things can wait, and some can go entirely.

games.name: Priority Puzzle
games.how: Urgent, important or neither? Sort the made-up tasks.
games.teaches: Do the important things before they become urgent.

games.name: Decision Maker
games.how: Several things at once. What deserves your attention first?
games.teaches: When everything feels urgent, pick the thing with a real deadline or real harm.

games.name: To-Do Dash
games.how: Put the steps in a sensible order.
games.teaches: Breaking tasks into steps makes them startable.

games.name: Clutter Crusher
games.how: Keep, donate, recycle or bin? Clear the messy virtual desk.
games.teaches: Every item needs a home or an exit.

games.name: Day Packer
games.how: Fit the tasks into the time you've actually got.

games.name: Mind Maze
games.how: Watch the path light up, then trace it back from memory.
games.teaches: Train your focus a little every day.
